name: use-focus-trap
title: useFocusTrap
description: Keeps Tab focus inside an element while it is active, and returns focus when it closes.
a11y: Tab and Shift+Tab cycle inside the container while active. Focus moves in on activation.
Focus returns to the element that had it before when the trap ends. Escape to close is the caller's job.

props.name: active
props.description: Whether Tab is trapped right now.

props.name: return
props.description: A ref to attach to the container that holds focus.
